mission: Connect a source-grounded signal to appropriate completed action and measured benefit while retaining local context and uncertainty

subject_key.meaning: Authorized pseudonymous research key; no identity inferred from aggregate data
subject_key.missing: Do not fabricate an individual record

population_eligibility.meaning: Target population, inclusion/exclusion, reference event and age definition

source_record.meaning: Original publisher, source version, permitted use, exact input hash and source observation identifier

geography.meaning: Observed unit, identifier, period and optional authorized versioned crosswalk

symptom_onset_recalled_at.meaning: Patient-reported onset and date of recall retained separately

first_recorded_signal_at.meaning: First captured relevant signal; not asserted first-ever onset/contact

first_actionable_information_at.meaning: Contemporaneously available information adjudicated as actionable under the condition and setting protocol
first_actionable_information_at.authority: Qualified reviewer, not retrospective diagnosis alone

recognition_at.meaning: Recorded acknowledgment by the responsible clinical workflow

planned_action.meaning: Clinician-approved response including appropriate observation, evaluation or shared-decision management

review_due_at.meaning: Indication-specific agreed reassessment date; no synthetic exercise date becomes clinical policy

completed_action_at.meaning: Evidence that the appropriate response occurred; order, message and attendance alone do not establish resolution

completion_evidence.meaning: Authorized result/record, source, reviewer and exact version

followup_interval_days.meaning: Elapsed time from specified actionable event to verified appropriate completion
followup_interval_days.censoring: Retain unresolved, loss, alternative disposition, declined care and time horizon; do not replace with zero

abnormal_non_colonoscopy_test_followup.meaning: Separate abnormal screening-test pathway from symptomatic evaluation; retain modality, indication, confirmation and clinical target source

patient_choice.meaning: Accepted, declined, paused or unknown with authorized reason and return plan; no automatic noncompliance label

sdoh_context.meaning: Temporally appropriate authorized affordability, coverage, transport, language, housing, food, work/care burden, trust, exposure and capacity evidence; individual and area-level values remain distinct

outcomes.meaning: Condition-specific benefit, function, harms, equity, cost and sustainment with source and observation period

knowledge_state.meaning: Known-at-decision evidence, alternatives, assumptions, uncertainty and subsequent revision; do not overwrite history

code_mapping_acceptance: Retain original publication code list, vocabulary version and permitted use; review inclusions/exclusions, negate/history context and clinician-adjudicated performance before use
